title: Semaglutide and Cardiovascular Outcomes in Obesity without Diabetes (SELECT)
book_use: Chapter 4; The Ozempic Economy; Checked 2026-09-02; Supports: 20% relative reduction in the primary cardiovascular composite; large multinational randomized trial; higher treatment discontinuation with semaglutide; Limits: Trial population restricted to people with overweight or obesity and pre-existing cardiovascular disease without diabetes; not generalizable to all GLP-1 users.
